name: command-menu
title: Command menu
description: The ⌘K palette: search every action and page, then run one with Enter.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The search field's placeholder. Defaults to the `commandPlaceholder` label.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches; gets the query. Defaults to the `noResultsFor` label.

props.name: hints
props.description: Show the footer of key hints.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal blocks the page and shows the overlay; turn it off for inline previews.

props.name: query
props.description: The search text. Pass it with onQueryChange to control it; it is emptied each time the menu closes.

props.name: header
props.description: Above the search row, such as a Breadcrumb of the pages opened so far.

props.name: footer
props.description: Key hints in place of Navigate, Open and Close; compose them from KbdHint. Shown when `hints` is on.

props.name: children
props.description: Shown in place of the list, such as an answer to the query; the search row and the footer stay.
